result.summary: This session performed the fifteenth pre-admission trigger search over a scope explicitly disjoint from rounds seven through fourteen: p-adic (Hensel-lifting) methods for polynomial system solving over Z_p/Q_p. Six candidates were considered: C1 (black-box Hensel lifting of implicit p-adic-analytic systems, instantiated on a genuinely new 2026 elliptic-curve endomorphism trace result, eprint.iacr.org/2026/137), C2 (multivariate/relaxed p-adic Hensel-Newton lifting of algebraic and triangular systems), C3 (tropical reformulation of Hensel's lemma for ultrametric root counting, arXiv:1107.1162), C4 (classical modular Hensel lifting for exact GCD/resultant/factorization reconstruction), C5 (rigid-analytic/Berkovich-space continuation), and C6 (this program's own internally derived canonical prime-to-p torsion lift, KN-TECH-73630e, applied here for the first time to the P1553 g_I/r_R object). This round's mandatory question was answered cleanly and positively for the first time in the trigger-search chain: p-adic exactness genuinely avoids round fourteen's archimedean field-mismatch obstruction, since Z_p reduces to F_p canonically and exactly (confirmed directly for C1 and C6). Three further, distinct obstructions close every candidate anyway: a genuinely new REFINEMENT-NOT-DISCOVERY obstruction (multivariate p-adic Hensel-Newton lifting is, by Hensel's lemma's own definition, a precision-refinement operator requiring an already-known root as its seed, not a search/discovery operator, unlike complex numerical continuation's witness sets -- C2); a WRONG-DIRECTION MISMATCH (classical modular Hensel lifting targets reconstructing an expensive Z/Q answer from a cheap mod-p base case, the opposite of what a prime-field-native target needs -- C4); and an INFORMATION-THEORETIC-EMPTINESS obstruction supplied by this program's own prior internal derivation (the cleanest-available p-adic construction, a canonical torsion-point lift, is independently proven to be a group isomorphism carrying zero additional information -- C6). C1 is the round's sharpest near-miss, confirming the exactness bridge works precisely where the literature supports it (a Hasse-bounded scalar with an efficient circuit) while showing neither enabling condition holds for r_R mod g_I. C3 fails on output type (a count, not a transducer), mirroring round fourteen's C6 via a genuinely distinct non-archimedean mechanism. C5 supplied no retrieved computational algorithm at all. Every candidate is judged item-by-item against the frozen gate (G1-G8, amended G2/G8 wording); none passes every item. The proof-search-map.yaml applies the four mandated cheap audits plus the lossy-projection test, all confirming the same structural verdicts by an independent route, and performs the mandatory item-by-item collision check against round fourteen's six candidates, confirming genuine mechanistic disjointness for every candidate this round. The source-novelty-audit.yaml labels every source recalled, retrieved, kb, or internal, confirms no overlap with the six screened pre-admission packets, the two P1553 mixed-radix packets' own reviews, the z_R construction-cost avenue's own closure, or the seventh- through fourteenth-round trigger searches, and assigns novelty_status known, adaptation, or unverified per candidate with no claim exceeding retrieved, kb, or internal evidence.
